text: Steenbarger: move to a daily trigger. My own G trigger was trade_above:bar_high on D, a buy stop 1 tick over yesterday's high, re-placed each session (C27); h1_close_above:bar_high acts on a 1-hour bar my system does not read. livermore and minervini are right on the daily frame. I do not add minervini's 1.4x volume test: it skips signals the criteria generate (C19, C31). Thesis holds: D close_vs_swing_high_pct 1.74, W close_vs_swing_high_pct 9.76. Cautions: D below EMA9, pos_in_day_range_pct 2.3. Wrong if a daily close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d) (C29).
